## Critical Spares: Two Exposures and One Recurring Stock-Out

**Two parts are EXPOSED today:** haul truck wheel assemblies run out 20 days before their sole supplier (Kwinana OTR Wheel Works) reopens, and ship loader drive motors face a 36-day gap when Pilbara Electric Motors closes. The same 200 kW motor also stocked out for 49 days in Q1 FY2027, signaling chronic procurement under-performance.

**Root cause chain:**  
The motor (MZ-SP-A101) from HighTec Assembling / Pilbara Electric Motors has a 180-day supplier closure (alert ALR-2026-1022-02), yet only 144 days of cover—leaving a 36-day exposure window. Last quarter it stocked out for 49 days, proving the reorder point (4 units) and safety stock are inadequate.

**Recommended action:** Expedite an emergency order of 8–10 units of MZ-SP-A101 from an alternate supplier **this week** to bridge the 36-day gap, and simultaneously negotiate pre-positioning of 20 BKS-400 wheel assemblies before 1 December 2026 to cover the haul fleet through Kwinana's 60-day closure.
